info.title: Vatra app API
info.description: Contract between the Vatra hub and its native apps. apiVersion 1, minClient 1 (GET /api/discover). Errors are { ok:false, code, error } with `error` in the device language (Accept-Language or x-vatra-locale).

deviceAuth.description: Paired device token (POST /api/devices/pair). Header only, never in the URL.

get.summary: Who this device acts as, and what it may do
get.description: Any household member's paired device; room grants apply.

get.summary: Rooms, devices and live Home Assistant states the member may see
get.description:
Rooms and devices outside the member's grants are left out entirely. haOnline=false means states is empty and the app should show the last known values.

Any household member's paired device; room grants apply.

post.summary: Control one device (toggle, light, climate, select, media) or run a house scene
post.description:
Entity commands need control of that entity's room (403 no_room_access otherwise); ambilight and scripts need control of at least one room.

Any household member's paired device; room grants apply.

400.description: invalid_request: the body does not match the schema

502.description: upstream_failed: Home Assistant did not carry out the command

post.summary: Set lights, apply a scene or undo the last change
post.description:
target: dev:<id> | seg:<id> | group:<id> | room:<room> | all. Every light the target expands to must be in a room the member controls.

Any household member's paired device; room grants apply.
